name: Haier Android TV DVB2K (broadway, HaierATVT56DVB; also sold as the CANDY Android TV DVB2K, CANDYATVT56)
warnings: Never launch these either, not just keep them enabled: on this Haier/CVTE board family, opening one is reported to flip a factory-mode flag and disable Play Services, Netflix and Chromecast on the next boot with no way back from the shell.
